pages.title: Kilo Snatch
pages.text: §lStats: §r Attack damage +20, attack speed +1, entity interaction range +3.5; epic rarity, unstackable, fire resistant.$(br2)§lProgram Loot: §r Hits have a 44% chance to inflict Program Loot for 10 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack reduces the target's attack damage, armor and max health by 10%.$(br2)$(italic)With Better Combat installed, it is held as a two-handed greatsword.

pages.title: Active Skill: Detonate
pages.text: §lSneak + right-click: §r Detonates Program Loot on every living entity within 8 blocks and removes the effect.$(br2)§lDamage: §r Each stack of Program Loot, plus each other potion effect on the target, deals 2% of its max health, capped at 44%.$(br2)§lCooldown: §r 10 seconds.$(br2)Targets without Program Loot still take damage if they have other potion effects.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Crafting table: middle column is Crying Obsidian, Nether Star and Netherite Ingot from top to bottom; Obsidian on both sides of the Nether Star.
